text: You see a Paladin.
source_text: You see a Paladin.

text: Pssst, see any good deals?
source_text: Pssst, see any good deals?

text: Sorry, I'm on duty. Can't talk right now.
source_text: Sorry, I'm on duty. Can't talk right now.

text: What a nice day. I hope we don't have any attacks today.
source_text: What a nice day. I hope we don't have any attacks today.

text: Good day.
source_text: Good day.

text: Some of these Caravan traders are a little strange.
source_text: Some of these Caravan traders are a little strange.

text: Hi there good looking.
source_text: Hi there good looking.

text: Greetings initiate.
source_text: Greetings initiate.

text: If you have any questions about our order you should talk to Cabbot#over by the door.

If you have any questions about our order you should talk to Cabbot

text: Cabbot is the one you want to talk to, he's the young lad by the door.
source_text: Cabbot is the one you want to talk to, he's the young lad by the door.

text: If you're here to trade you're talking to the wrong person.
source_text: If you're here to trade you're talking to the wrong person.

text: What?
source_text: What?

text: Don't bother me worm.
source_text: Don't bother me worm.

text: Do I look like I'm interested in anything you might have to offer.
source_text: Do I look like I'm interested in anything you might have to offer.

text: Hmph. The nerve.
source_text: Hmph. The nerve.

text: I'm on watch, don't disturb me.
source_text: I'm on watch, don't disturb me.

text: Initiate, you should know better than to bother us while we're on watch.
source_text: Initiate, you should know better than to bother us while we're on watch.

text: Initiate, shouldn't you be doing something useful.
source_text: Initiate, shouldn't you be doing something useful.

text: If you have any questions about our order you should talk to Cabbot#over by the door.
source_text:
If you have any questions about our order you should talk to Cabbot
#over by the door.

text: I don't think you should be here stranger.
source_text: I don't think you should be here stranger.

text: 你看见一个游侠。
source_text: 你看见一个游侠。

text: 咳，看看有什么好货？
source_text: 咳，看看有什么好货？

text: 对不起，我在值班。现在不能谈话。
source_text: 对不起，我在值班。现在不能谈话。

text: 好天气。我希望我们今天不要有任何行动。
source_text: 好天气。我希望我们今天不要有任何行动。

text: 日安。
source_text: 日安。

text: 有些商队的人怪怪的。
source_text: 有些商队的人怪怪的。

text: 嗨，气色不错。
source_text: 嗨，气色不错。

text: 你好，新兵。
source_text: 你好，新兵。

text: 如果你对我们的命令有任何疑问就去问守门的卡波特。
source_text: 如果你对我们的命令有任何疑问就去问守门的卡波特。

text: 你是来找卡波特的吧，门口那个年轻人就是。
source_text: 你是来找卡波特的吧，门口那个年轻人就是。

text: 如果你打算交易那你找错人了。
source_text: 如果你打算交易那你找错人了。

text: 什么？
source_text: 什么？

text: 不要搔扰我，可怜虫。
source_text: 不要搔扰我，可怜虫。

text: 你认为我会对你的那点东西感兴趣吗？
source_text: 你认为我会对你的那点东西感兴趣吗？

text: 咳，神经。
source_text: 咳，神经。

text: 我在值班，不要搔扰我。
source_text: 我在值班，不要搔扰我。

text: 新兵，你应该知道在我们忙着的时候不喜欢被打扰。
source_text: 新兵，你应该知道在我们忙着的时候不喜欢被打扰。

text: 新兵，你能不能做点有用的事。

text: 我想这不是你该呆的地方，陌生人。
